description: Changes banks have made to card rules since a date: devaluations, fee changes, lounge gates, transfer partners added or removed, improvements. Newest first, upcoming ones included and marked. Each change carries the date it takes effect, the cards it touches, grade, check date, source and its own page on getbrief.cards.

limit.description: At most this many changes. 20 if unset.

severity.description: One kind of change: devaluation, fee_change, lounge_gating, partner_removed, partner_added, retention_rule, enhancement. enhancement is an improvement.

since.description: Changes taking effect on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: And on or before this date.

name: list_changes
title: Dated bank changes
